messages:
samir: FYI team 1: we need to announce the deprecation plan for the legacy 'v1/chat_stream' endpoint in the docs. Targeting removal in 2 major SDK releases. Draft PR up at /docs/deprecation/v1-chat-stream.md — please review.

june: Pinged. Can you add a short migration checklist? We should show the new call shape + tips for maintaining streaming semantics.

samir: Good call. I'll add a checklist and quick code diff for each SDK (py/js/go). Example diff will show explicit `stream=True` -> `stream: {type: server_sent_events}` mapping.

kai: Important: ensure examples mention the fallback policy. We promised a 2-release grace window with logs that warn once per host. Also need a note for Dedicated customers about config pinning.

samir: Added that to the draft: grace_window = 2 releases; warning logs emitted by runtime-level shim; Dedicated customers can opt-out by setting legacy_streaming: true in deployment config.

maria: Can we include a quick test people can run locally? e.g. `python examples/stream_test.py --endpoint v1/chat_stream` to verify behavior before migrating.

samir: Yes -- adding a tiny test harness and a script: `tools/check_stream_examples.sh` which automates run & asserts SSE frames.

june: Also update the SDK changelog template so release notes automatically include a compat line when removing endpoints. Small snippet for release PR template: `compat: removed v1/chat_stream (deprecated since 2024-11), migration-guide: /docs/deprecation/v1-chat-stream.md`

kai: Docs-bot: can you schedule a dry-run deploy of the docs site with the deprecation page under /next so we can QA before public announcement?

docs-bot: scheduled dry-run deploy (id: docs-dryrun-2031-03). Live preview: https://preview.docs.internal/deprecation/v1-chat-stream. Expiry: 72h.

maria: I ran the script against python/js examples, found two JS examples that rely on implicit stream frames (chatbox UI). Opening PRs to explicitly set new stream shape.

samir: Thanks. For internal comms — I'll prepare a one-paragraph blurb for #announcements and a follow-up email for enterprise customers (Dedicated/Private) covering pinning instructions and contact for migration support.

june: Can we also add an opt-in flag in Redwood Console to 'show deprecated APIs' so teams can find examples using old endpoints?

kai: Good idea. I'll open a Console ticket. We should also add telemetry to count usage of v1/chat_stream so SRE/product can track ramp-down.

samir: Adding telemetry event: docs.deprecation.v1_chat_stream.detected. Will coordinate with infra to ensure counting.

docs-bot: nightly docs linter passed; dry-run deploy is up.

maria: PRs for the JS fixes: #5789 & #5790. One minor markdown tweak in the migration guide.
